# Letterhome

> A Canadian letter mailing service. We print and mail physical letters and documents from Canada.

## What Letterhome does

Letterhome is an online service that accepts a letter or document from anyone — anywhere in the world — prints it in full colour on standard letter-size paper, seals it in an envelope, applies Canadian postage, and deposits it with Canada Post for delivery.

The service operates from Canada. Every letter carries a Canadian postmark.

## Who uses it

- Canadians living abroad who need to mail something to a Canadian address (government forms, legal documents, letters to family)
- Immigrants and newcomers to Canada sending documents back home
- People in Canada who want to mail a letter without buying stamps, envelopes, or making a trip to the post office
- Anyone outside Canada who needs to send a letter that arrives with Canadian postage

## Pricing

- $10 CAD — letters to any Canadian address (domestic)
- $20 CAD — letters to any of 160+ international destinations

Both prices include up to 5 documents of full-colour printing, the envelope, postage, and delivery. No account required. Pay once per order.

## How it works

1. Fill in the recipient address, compose or attach your letter, and enter your email.
2. Pay by credit or debit card through Stripe.
3. Letterhome prints the letter in full colour and mails it from Canada, usually within one business day.
4. The customer receives an email confirmation with an order tracking link.

## Delivery

Letters are mailed via Canada Post standard lettermail:
- Within Canada: typically up to 2 weeks
- International: typically up to 4 weeks

Tracked and registered options are available on request.
